rows.ARS:
Mauve or mauve blend Floribunda.
Exhibition name: Purple Moon
rows.Origin:
Bred by Colin Dickson (1956-....) (United Kingdom, before 2011).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Dickson Nurseries Ltd. / Dickson Roses in 2014 as 'Purple Moon'.
rows.Bloom: Pink, yellow stamens. Semi-double (9-16 petals), in small clusters, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
